title: Pre-Columbian Gold Museum and Plaza de la Cultura

groundCutout.basis: The mapped public square forms the built roof and includes its recessed public entrance. The mask is bounded by that native polygon and restores original terrain on unload.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain on the Calle 5 sidewalk beside the roof plaza.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named archaeological museum and supporting public plaza
names: Pre-Columbian Gold Museum and Plaza de la Cultura
mapIdentity.scope: The Museo del Oro Precolombino and its built Plaza de la Cultura roof, with the recessed public approach on Calle 5, glazed entrance and underground concrete section.

note: The four corners of the mapped roof plaza and the signed entrance on Calle 5 locate the model. The museum owner documents a 12 m reinforced concrete enclosure with 60-degree inward sloping walls, three levels and a spiral stair. The original terrain grid was frozen before construction.
